summary: Iterasi 10 (Tutor register + onboarding + admin verification): 14/14 backend pytest passed and full frontend E2E flow passes AFTER fixing a critical redirect bug in RegisterTutor.js that immediately sent the just-registered pending tutor to /pending, preventing them from ever reaching /onboarding/tutor to upload CV+certs.

issues: Radix warning: Missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent (a11y warning, not blocking).

action_items: Review the small patch applied to /app/frontend/src/pages/RegisterTutor.js (redirect tutor pending w/o cv_url to /onboarding/tutor). Consider a more general fix (e.g., only running the redirect useEffect when user was already loaded pre-submit, not for freshly-registered users).
critical_code_review_comments: RegisterTutor.js useEffect race: setUser(newTutor) + navigate('/onboarding/tutor') in submit competes with the mount-time useEffect that redirects any pending non-admin to /pending. The useEffect wins because it re-runs on user change after commit. Applied minimal fix routing tutor+pending+no cv_url to /onboarding/tutor. Same latent risk exists in similar pages (Register.js / RegisterProctor.js) — verify.
DialogContent in ManageUsers.js is missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby (Radix a11y warning).
AuthContext exposes setUser directly; freshly registered user with cookies set means subsequent /auth/me would return the same object — OK, but there is no re-validation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (was 0% - blocked at onboarding step before fix)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 10 tutor flow (register/tentor → onboarding → upload CV(pdf) + cert(png<=2MB) → save profile → /pending → admin approves → tutor portal) fully working end-to-end after RegisterTutor.js redirect fix. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_tutor.py. Google 'become-tutor' path verified via API (student → become-tutor turns them to tutor pending). Real Google OAuth not executed (needs Emergent session).
rca of the issue: RCA: RegisterTutor.js line 18-23 useEffect: on any user state change where role=='tutor' && status=='pending', it navigated to /pending. When submit() called setUser(newTutor)+navigate('/onboarding/tutor'), React committed the new user, the useEffect fired and pushed /pending, overriding the manual navigate. Reproduction: fill and submit /register/tentor with a fresh email → within ~500ms the URL becomes /pending (observed via url polling), skipping onboarding entirely. Mitigation applied: when tutor is pending AND has no cv_url yet, redirect to /onboarding/tutor instead of /pending.
